resources.string: The server is taking a while. You can cancel this check and keep editing.
The server is saved, but did not connect. Check the address and sign-in, then try again.
Your server is connected. Your conversations stay on the server.
The changes you typed have not been saved.
Your password and conversations can be read by others on this network. Prefer HTTPS or a private Tailscale network. This choice applies only to this exact address.
A certificate is saved for this address. A changed certificate stops the connection.
Compare this SHA-256 fingerprint with the server owner using another trusted channel. A different certificate will stop the connection.
Connect both devices to the same Tailscale network. Use the computer’s 100.x address or its .ts.net name. Keep the server’s own password: Tailscale does not replace it.
Actions the agent may run in this project without asking. Revoke an action to ask again next time.
The agent will ask before running this action again. A running action is not stopped.
Could not read or change allowed actions. Check the connection and try again.
No always allowed actions in this project. The agent will ask when it needs permission.
Revoked: %1$s. The agent will ask next time.
Tailscale is installed. Open it, sign in and turn its VPN on. This app cannot check your VPN sign-in.
Install the official Tailscale app on this phone first.
Could not check the Tailscale app. Check again when it is available.
Reading waiting prompts and destination conversations…
Nothing was moved. The connection or waiting prompts changed, or storage refused the change. Refresh and review the selection again.
Move waiting prompts from %1$s to %2$s. Nothing is sent here. Passwords and keys in their words are hidden before the move.
No waiting prompts on this server.
This may already have been sent. Review it on its original server.
This attachment can only be opened on the original server.
Hiding a secret would change this prompt’s agent mentions. Edit it on the original server first.
This prompt is being sent. Wait for its result.
This prompt must stay on its original server.
Choose at least one movable prompt.
Moved %1$d prompts. %2$d stayed on the original server. %3$d use the destination’s model or agent choice. Nothing was sent.
Returned %1$d prompts that were still waiting. Prompts already sending stayed where they were.
This removes this app’s saved connection and local data. It does not delete conversations from the server.
%1$d waiting prompts will be deleted from this phone.
%1$d waiting prompts will be kept in Saved prompts.
%1$d prompts may already have been sent. A delivery that still needs review can stop removal.
%1$d saved conversation drafts will be removed.
The current connection will close. You will return to your saved servers.
The server keeps its conversations and files.
Checking what this phone keeps for the server…
Could not finish removing this server. It may be disconnected and some local cleanup may have finished. Your saved server stays while any required cleanup or delivery review is unfinished.
Leave this off to keep their words and attachments in Saved prompts.
Could not undo the move. Review the destination conversation before trying again; prompts that already started sending stay there.
This saved server or its sign-in changed. Close this page and open the server again before trying.
This server was removed. Close this page to return to your saved servers.
